pattern: (?i)\b(?:I|we|you|they|he|she)\s+(?:can(?:no|')t|can not|could(?:n't| not)|won't|will not|wouldn't|would not|didn't|did not|haven't|have not|hasn't|has not|(?:am|'m|was|were|is|are) (?:not able|unable) to)(?: also| still| even| just| really| yet)? (?P<target>delete|remove|revert|attach|forward|resend|reopen|rename|modify|undo|reassign|unassign|overwrite|discard|restore|edit|fix|find)(?:\s*[(,.;:!?)\n]|\s+(?:but|because|as|since|so|until|unless|though|either|now|yet|anymore|any more|myself|ourselves)\b|\s*$)
reason: Say what cannot be done: this verb needs an object.
positive: Hey, I cannot delete (don't have the permissions), but this role is good to delete.
negative: I cannot delete the file. You can delete or archive it. I cannot delete and recreate it. We can't remove any of them.

pattern: (?i)\bI\b[^.!?\n]*?(?:\(|, |,| - |—|–)\s*(?P<target>don't|do not|didn't|did not|haven't|have not|can't|cannot|couldn't|could not|won't|will not|wasn't|was not) (?:have|know|think|remember|want|need|see|like|understand|recall|get|mean|believe|suppose|care|expect)\b
reason: The aside needs its subject: “I don't have”.
positive: I will check later (don't know the answer yet).
negative: I tried, don't worry. I think they don't know. If I don't have time, I will skip it. I said (don't ask) and left.

pattern: (?i)\b(?:don't|dont|do not|doesn't|does not|didn't|did not|haven't|have not|hasn't|has not|never|no longer|not) (?:have|had|has|having|got|gotten) (?P<target>the permissions?)(?:\s*[(),.;:!?\n]|\s+(?:to|for|yet|anymore|any more|on|in|here|there|now|either|at all|so|but|because|as|since|and|or)\b|\s*$)
positive: I cannot delete it (don't have the permissions), but this role is good to delete.
negative: I have permission to delete it. He set the permissions on the folder. She doesn't have the permission set configured. Check the permissions list.
